pages.text: Ordinary item tasks recognize the required item in your inventory. They do not necessarily require you to craft it personally, and most do not take the item away.$(br2)Fluid sample tasks are different: they ask you to submit the stated amount. Produce extra so completing the task does not empty the supply your factory needs.
A completed quest is a useful milestone. Before beginning another large project, make sure you can repeat the process that earned it.
